facts.claim: Base constructor reads caller/factory deployment parameters by raw staticcall and initializes packed state/immutables; initializes SphereX operator and engine events.

invariant_candidates.candidate: Deposit increases account.scaledBalance and state.scaledTotalSupply by the same scaledAmount.
Transfer subtracts and adds identical scaledAmount between sender and receiver accounts; helper accrual may independently settle withdrawals.
Queue decreases account scaled balance and increases account batch status, batch scaledTotalAmount and state scaledPendingWithdrawals by the same amount.

Batch payment increases batch scaledAmountBurned and reduces state scaledPendingWithdrawals/scaledTotalSupply by the same scaled amount; normalized payment increases batch normalizedAmountPaid and state normalizedUnclaimedWithdrawals.
Successful incremental claim increases status.normalizedAmountWithdrawn and decreases state normalizedUnclaimedWithdrawals by the same normalized amount.
Constructor sets isClosed false; closeMarket is the only scoped writer setting true; no scoped reopen transition.
invariant_candidates.derivation: edge; check constructor and close write inventories

invariant_candidates.candidate: Pending expiry zero -> queue-created expiry -> expired zero; unpaid batch appended if not fully burned, removed from FIFO when fully burned. Closed-market same-timestamp handling is preserved in the scoped queue/close records.

limits: No runtime test or bytecode behavior is inferred from AST compilation.
Local event routes include library assembly log helpers and Solidity emit statements. External hook, token, sentinel and SphereX-engine event sets require their separately reviewed callee evidence.
Event reachability is conditional and describes successful paths. A downstream revert discards earlier transfers, storage writes and logs.
Guard/write inventories are syntactic evidence, not blanket global-invariant enforcement claims. Memory accounting writes commit only when the corresponding store helper completes.
Independent factory/identity/hook invariants require root cross-system review.
